B09J6MXJKT.title: Mopeka Pro Check Bluetooth Propane Tank Sensor, Magnetic, 250 Gallon Max
bullets: WIRELESS PROPANE GAUGE - This digital propane tank gauge is an essential tool for anyone who enjoys outdoor cooking or using propane-powered patio heaters. The Mopeka tank sensor connects to your phone through a mobile app, providing you with real-time updates on the propane level.

EASY TO INSTALL - Our propane tank gauge effortlessly attaches to the underside of your propane tank through powerful magnets. It can be secured in place to the tank level in seconds with enhanced ultrasonic capabilities. Even when traveling on uneven terrain, the sturdy magnets prevent our monitor sensor from detaching from your RV's propane tanks. This gas gauge for propane tank is designed to accommodate most standard and custom LPG tanks from 20lbs up to 120 gallon or 420 lbs. This sensor will not work with fiberglass tanks.

IMPROVED BATTERY - This propane tank fuel gauge is convenient for monitoring your propane levels without physically checking the tank. With the latest improvements in battery technology, propane tank gauge level indicator now has a longer-lasting battery, ensuring it remains operational for extended periods without needing to be recharged or replaced.

LATEST MODEL - Mopeka's latest patented ultrasonic sensor, the Pro Check, boasts enhanced reading quality and precision. This propane grill gauge features an integrated temperature sensor, tank "bubble level," configurable sample timing, firmware updates, alarms/alerts, and more. It supports both vertical and horizontal cylinders, making it a versatile option for propane tank monitoring.

FREE MOBILE APP - The Mopeka "Tank Check" app is free for download on Apple and Google Play stores. It allows unlimited tanks and sensors with customizable alarms. You can access the propane tank gauge app remotely using the Mopeka Wifi Bridge or monitor your tanks without a phone using the Mopeka Monitor (available for purchase separately).

This sensor is configured specifically for use in North American and non-European/UK markets. The Mopeka Co-Pilot App and Tank Check App are compatible only with this model in these regions. This unit will not function in European and UK Markets.

B0FBSQV5HR.title: Wireless Propane Tank Gauge Sensor - Bluetooth Propane Level Indicator for BBQ, Camping & Outdoor Cooking - Propane Tank Monitor for Steel, Aluminum & Composite Cylinders - App Compatible - Senso4s
bullets: MADE IN EUROPE & REAL-TIME MONITORING – Connect via Bluetooth (BLE) to the free Senso4s app (iOS & Android) to monitor gas levels in real time, receive low-gas alerts, and view usage forecasts directly on your smartphone from up to 66 feet (20 meters) away. The device is proudly designed and produced in Europe.

UNIVERSAL FIT FOR STANDARD CYLINDERS – Designed to fit all common propane tanks made of steel, aluminum, or composite. Adjustable pull-out feet accommodate base diameters from 7-13 inches (180–320 mm)—ideal for BBQ grills, patio heaters, and camping stoves.

PRECISION GAS MEASUREMENT – Delivers ±1% accuracy for loads between 7-99 pounds (3–45 kg), with safe overload protection up to 198 pounds (90 kg). Get reliable propane readings whether you're grilling, cooking, or heating.

CERTIFIED WEATHER-RESISTANT BUILD – Rugged ABS/PC housing with IP44 protection (equivalent to NEMA 3R) handles outdoor conditions from 14–104 degrees Fahrenheit (-10°C to +40°C). Complies with FCC regulations for wireless devices, meets UL CERTIFIED safety standards, and includes a NEMA-compliant 3R enclosure to resist dust and moisture.

QUICK SETUP & LONG BATTERY LIFE – Installs in seconds with 3x AAA batteries (not included), offering up to 18 months of use. Lightweight at only 1 pound (0.28 kg), making it the perfect companion for outdoor adventures and everyday propane use.

bullets: ALWAYS HAVE PROPANE READY: Don’t worry about running out of propane again! With this digital gas indicator, you can track and monitor the levels of your large or small tank, so you never run out of gas in the middle of a good barbecue!
WEIGHS & MEASURES MOST GAS TANKS: Get the most accurate measuring of weight! Track and monitor the gas levels of most propane gas tanks.

LONG-LASTING BATTERY OPERATED: The red LED indicator illuminates during connection and is NOT a power light. Our scale can last for 3 months and over A YEAR if connected to our app. This device requires 2-AA batteries (not included).

Device Compatibility Requirements: (1) iOS Devices - iPhone running iOS 15.0 or later, iPad running iPadOS 15.0 or later, Bluetooth 4.0 or higher (2) Android Devices - Android 11 (Android OS version 11.0) or later, Bluetooth 4.0 or higher, Device must support Google Play Services
